mapping.summary: Paste copied rows from Excel, CSV or email straight into 80+ BC pages as records.
claims: Paste area on more than 80 BC pages
Accepts data from Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, web pages and email
Auto-detects tab, comma, semicolon and pipe separators
Accepts drag-and-drop of text or files
Matches column headers to fields by caption or name
Default values for unmapped fields with lookups
Whole paste rolls back on error and reports failing row and column
Works on journals including general, payment, item, fixed asset and warehouse journals
Works on sales, purchase and service documents, transfer and assembly orders
Works on master data such as customers, vendors, items, contacts and chart of accounts
Works on requisition, planning and subcontracting worksheets
Uses each table's own validation so other extensions still apply
Developer events to override paste, column matching and new records
